description:
Port-map §9. Tie everything together + wire into the coder CLI.

- OctoPi.Tui.Interactive: main loop. Starts Terminal, StdinFSM,
  Renderer. Subscribes to Agent session events. Renders session
  transcript via a stack of components: Text (history) +
  SelectList (slash menu, if active) + Input/Editor (prompt).
  Routes keys through KeyParser to the focused component.
- OctoPi.Coder.CLI.run/1: add :mode → :interactive branch. When
  no --print and no --mode rpc, dispatch to Interactive.
- Graceful exit on Ctrl+C (double-press within 1s to confirm),
  Ctrl+D at empty input, /exit slash command.

Definition of done: `mix pi` opens an interactive TUI that
stream-renders assistant turns with flicker-free updates and a
working editor input against FakeTransport. `mix pi` against live
Anthropic (opt-in integration test) runs a prompt turn to
completion with no terminal corruption on exit.

TDD:
- `CLI.parse_args([])` now yields :mode → :interactive (was an
  error in Phase 3).
- Integration test (@tag :integration) driving FakeTransport
  through Interactive; assert final rendered frame contains the
  assistant text.
- Terminal restoration on crash: spawn Interactive in a task,
  kill it, verify RawMode.exit was called (monitor + telemetry).

Depends on .2, .3, .4, .5, .7. (Does not strictly require .6
overlay or .8 editor; start with just Input from .7.)
title: Interactive mode glue + CLI dispatch + E2E smoke
